C1407.title: Devin Rhoden and Berman Nowlin NFT Rug Pull and Money Laundering Case
C1407.summary: Devin Alan Rhoden (aka Denny/Deviinz) and Berman Jerry Nowlin Jr. (aka Repulse) were charged with orchestrating an NFT 'rug pull' scheme and laundering proceeds through blockchain transactions. They allegedly defrauded investors through false promotions before absconding with the funds, and were indicted by the U.S. Department of Justice on conspiracy to commit wire fraud and money laundering.
